original_ai_output.title_zh: 拉各斯-伊巴丹高速公路发生车祸，一人死亡三人受伤
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚奥贡州拉各斯-伊巴丹高速公路Danco路段发生一起车祸，一辆马自达巴士与一辆卡车相撞，造成一名男性乘客死亡、三人受伤。奥贡州交通合规与执法机构发言人表示，事发时车内有八人。该信息目前仅来自单一来源。

location.raw_text: Danco section of the Lagos-Ibadan Expressway, inward Lagos, Ogun State

key_facts.fact: 拉各斯-伊巴丹高速公路Danco路段一辆马自达巴士与一辆卡车相撞
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A male passenger has died while three others were injured when a Mazda bus collided with a truck at the Danco section of the Lagos-Ibadan Expressway, inward Lagos, Ogun State.

key_facts.fact: 事故造成一名男性乘客死亡、三人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: One male passenger has died and three others were injured in a crash involving a Mazda bus and a truck

key_facts.fact: 事发时车内有八人，包括四男四女
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: eight people, comprising four men and four women, were in the bus when the accident occurred
The crash, which occurred on Monday night
